issue.author: internal-review-repo
issue.body:
Review of the assembled delivery (paper-repo `bbd16d05544f`, experiment-repo `741117527edc`, figtab-repo `c1862c13793d`).

Verified: `code/fit.py` re-runs in a copy of the delivery and reproduces `results/fit.json` and `results/data.csv` exactly; the values match my independent fit (`review/reference_check.out` in internal-review-repo): slope 0.8140 [0.7283, 0.8997], intercept 1.9142 [−0.0273, 3.8557], R² 0.9068. `figures/make_fit_figure.py` regenerates `figures/fit.png`; I opened the figure, and it is correct and labelled. The "borderline against zero" statement holds (two-sided p = 0.053).

Findings in `report/report.md`:
1. **The figure is not presented.** The Figure section says "see `figures/` (figtab-repo; one figure, filename in the delivery)". It neither names nor embeds `figures/fit.png`, so the report's one required figure does not resolve from the report. Fix: embed it with a relative link that resolves from `report/` (`![Figure 1](../figures/fit.png)`), and give a short caption based on `figures/caption.md`. The caption should say that the shaded band is the CI for the mean line and that the dashed line is the true line.
2. **The figure's code is missing from the provenance.** Reproduction lists only `code/fit.py`. The objective asks for the code behind every number "next to" the report, so also cite `figures/make_fit_figure.py` (it reads `figures/data.csv` and `figures/fit.json`) as the code that produced the figure.
issue.title: Review: report must present the figure and cite its code
